entities.name: PMID:33986027
observations: Danish nationwide register cohort of 60,534 adults aged 18–45 treated with inhaled corticosteroids; specialist management was assessed for 3,275 with possible severe asthma.
Among possible severe asthma patients, odds of specialist management were lower for ages 36–45 versus 18–25 (OR 0.66, 95% CI 0.51–0.85).

entities.name: Age and asthma specialist care
observations: In a Danish cohort of adults aged 18–45 with possible severe asthma, age 36–45 was associated with 34% lower odds of specialist management than age 18–25 (OR 0.66, 95% CI 0.51–0.85). Findings are limited to the study setting, age range, and severe-asthma subgroup.
